Sets how small the user may make a window. Without the sizes, the current size of the window becomes the smallest one. The biggest size is always the size of the desktop.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Not too small", 20, 20, 240, 160, Desktop(), 15)
SetMinWindowSize win, 160, 100
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
@param window  Handle of a window that can be resized.
@param width   Smallest width. Defaults to -1, which takes the current width.
@param height  Smallest height. Defaults to -1, which takes the current height.
@gap The help lists height before width in its syntax line, the real order is width then height.
